Gettin’ started.Must me ship run Librescoot to use the a: Nay. The app can command an unu Scooter Pro with stock software. A ship runnin’ Librescoot reveals extra treasure such as navigation, keycards, power settings, alarms, and Bluetooth refits.
Gettin’ started.Can the old official app stay aboard?: Aye. The apps sail separately, but only one can link to the ship at a time. Turn off background connection in the old app. On iOS, remove the old pairing in system settings if this app cannot pair.
Gettin’ started.Can several phones command one ship?: Aye. Up to six devices can be paired, but only one may command the ship at a time. Each sailor should keep a keycard handy in case the pairing must be restored.

Connection and pairin’.Why can’t the app find me ship?: Stand beside the powered-on ship and check that Bluetooth be enabled and no other phone be connected. A Bluetooth mark on the dashboard usually means another device already holds the link.
Connection and pairin’.Why did a pairin’ request appear before: Some phones show an early request before the ship displays its code. Dismiss it and continue in the app. Accept the request that appears when the code be visible on the ship.
Connection and pairin’.What if reconnectin’ keeps failin’?: Close other scooter apps, toggle Bluetooth, and try again beside the ship. Check that a keycard still unlocks it. If not, the trouble may be aboard the ship rather than the phone.

Librescoot.What be Librescoot?: Librescoot be an independent, open-source operating system for the unu Scooter Pro. It replaces abandoned cloud services with local control, navigation, refits, and features kept afloat by the community.
Librescoot.Does this app install Librescoot?: Nay. Follow the installation guide in the Librescoot handbook. Once installed, the app can manage supported settings and deliver compatible firmware refits over Bluetooth.
Librescoot.Where can a sailor get help?: Start with the handbook and troubleshooting guide. Ask the Librescoot Discord crew for individual help. Use GitHub issues for repeatable software bugs and clear feature requests.

About the app.Who makes this app?: This be an independent, open-source community project for unu Scooter Pro sailors. It be no official app from the shipbuilder or brand owner.
About the app.What data leaves me phone?: Ship commands travel directly over Bluetooth. Optional online features may request charts, address lookup, notices, or firmware information. App diagnostics be shared only when ye start a report.
About the app.How can I lend a hand?: Source code and issue tracking live on GitHub. Contributions to code, translations, documentation, testing, and design be welcome.
